newsitem.title: USA: Phoenix Resources sees Q2 shr about $0.12.
newsitem.headline: Phoenix Resources sees Q2 shr about $0.12.

text.p: Phoenix Resources Technologies Inc said Friday that its preliminary unaudited income for the second quarter should be about $14 million gross and $1.3 million net pre-tax, or $0.12 a share.
The company attributed the income solely to the sale of assets to its interest in MVP Holdings Inc.
The company also said it has no ownership in Hughes wood products, which it said it sold in 1996.
It said it has warranties and contractual representations from its prior management that the company is not at risk.
The company did not elaborte and could not immediately be reached for further comment.
